name: Exalting Yourself
overview: Scripture warns against the folly of exalting oneself, highlighting that such pride leads to humiliation while humility brings exaltation. Proverbs cautions that lifting oneself up foolishly is unwise and calls for restraint in speech and attitude. Isaiah reveals that human pride and haughtiness will ultimately be humbled, affirming that only the Lord deserves true exaltation. Luke emphasizes the principle that those who exalt themselves will be brought low, whereas those who humble themselves will be lifted up, underscoring the need for a Christ-centered humility.
